title: Ooma Review (2026)
intro: Ooma is evaluated here as a cloud business phone system — Ooma Office is an SMB cloud phone system with transparent monthly per-user pricing and no required annual contract: Essentials $19.95, Pro $24.95 and Pro Plus $29.95 per user/month (USD) confirmed on Ooma’s Office pricing chart (last updated 2026-04-15; retrieved 2026-08-17). Unlimited calling to US/Canada/Mexico/Puerto Rico, virtual receptionist and ring groups sit on Essentials; Pro adds meetings, recording, SMS (account caps) and voicemail transcription; Pro Plus adds call queues, CRM integrations and larger meetings. Ooma Enterprise is a separate custom line for larger contact-centre needs. Scored as a mid/low phone-cluster peer — overall ≥6.5 warrants a phone rank below the CallHippo/KrispCall band rather than landscape-only. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s business-communications methodology (ease of use, voice/messaging quality, routing and workflows, integrations, analytics, outbound tools, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Ooma when you want an affordable SMB business phone with published monthly floors and no annual contract — especially under ~15 seats.
verdict: Choose Ooma when you want an affordable SMB business phone with published monthly floors and no annual contract — especially under ~15 seats. Compare CallHippo for dialer-adjacent SMB value, Vonage for promo annual per-line packaging, OpenPhone for modern shared-number UX, and Grasshopper for the simplest virtual-number entry. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: No-contract monthly plans and clear Essentials/Pro/Pro Plus ladder make Ooma easy for small teams to adopt. Score from documented packaging, not lab testing.
Reliable SMB VoIP with unlimited North America calling; meetings and SMS deepen on Pro+. Solid mid/low voice envelope — not carrier-grade global UCaaS.
Virtual receptionist and ring groups on Essentials; queues and expanded receptionist on Pro Plus. Credible SMB routing without CCaaS depth.
Google/Microsoft on lower tiers; Salesforce/HubSpot on Pro Plus. Thinner than Aircall/Nextiva CTI catalogues.
Call logs and Pro analytics cover SMB reporting; trails mid-market UCaaS analytics.
SMS on Pro+ and auto-dialer on Pro Plus only — mid/low outbound without a true power dialer story.
Excellent under ~15 seats; Office packaging thins for multi-site contact-centre growth — Enterprise is a separate custom product.
Transparent $19.95 Essentials with no annual lock-in is strong SMB value. SMS caps and Pro Plus upsells temper all-in TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Transcription features on Pro/Pro Plus; no Sona-class AI answering packaging — mid-low AI score.

faq.question: Is Ooma a business phone system?
faq.answer: Yes. Ooma is a cloud business phone system: virtual numbers, inbound and outbound calling, softphone apps and call routing. It is not a CRM of record — keep your CRM and connect it for call logging.

faq.question: How is Ooma priced?
faq.answer: Essentials $19.95, Pro $24.95, Pro Plus $29.95 per user/month USD confirmed on Ooma Office pricing chart (updated 2026-04-15; retrieved 2026-08-17). Extra numbers $9.95/mo; SMS packs beyond caps. No annual lock-in. High confidence.

faq.question: Does Ooma have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Ooma?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
